question.knowledge_point: Plotting the Product of a Matrix and an Eigenvector Given its Corresponding Eigenvalue
question.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071103/assets/61ed37aa6a5e67cdc60cca2c93969a47d12e1e36f18edf96f646922877641e79.png)

The vector $u$ is an eigenvector of a $2\times 2$ matrix $A$ corresponding to the eigenvalue $\frac{1}{2}.$ Find the vector $Au.$
question.worked_solution:
The eigenvector $u=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0\end{aligned}]$ corresponds to the eigenvalue $\lambda =\frac{1}{2}.$ So, 

$$
\begin{aligned}Au & =\frac{1}{2}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, we have the following picture:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071103/assets/c272ff1454ac4ab9825e312f563c9bca08ac2800faa0e95ab45e8a5e827369da.png)
